Done when: /opt/enforce/fixtures/R8/flag and /opt/enforce/fixtures/R8/pass each hold at least two files; as the agent, the check exits 1 and names R8 for every file in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R8/flag, and exits 0 for every file in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R8/pass.
